name: Bot CPS Glow
description: Makes Mega Hack's CPS counter pulse green for bot-generated gameplay inputs.

enabled.name: Enable Bot CPS Glow
enabled.description: Pulse the Mega Hack CPS counter when supported bots generate gameplay inputs.

pulse-period.name: Pulse Period
pulse-period.description: Duration of one green pulse cycle in milliseconds.

pulse-strength.name: Green Strength
pulse-strength.description: How strongly the original CPS colour blends toward green.

pulse-linger.name: Click Linger
pulse-linger.description: Keeps the pulse visible briefly after a short bot click/release, so 1-tick inputs can still be seen.

all-buttons.name: All Gameplay Buttons
all-buttons.description: Also react to platformer Left/Right bot inputs. Off = Jump only.

generic-detection.name: Generic Bot Detection
generic-detection.description: Treat unknown DLLs with names containing bot/macro/replay/TAS terms as automated input sources.

extra-module-tokens.name: Extra Module Tokens
extra-module-tokens.description: Comma-separated DLL/mod ID fragments to treat as bots. Example: mybot, author.customreplay

fallback-cps-scan.name: Fallback CPS Text Scan
fallback-cps-scan.description: If Mega Hack node IDs are unavailable, fall back to finding visible labels containing CPS.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Log detected bot input source modules when the source changes.
